caseNameFull: George Bird, Individually and as Trustees, etc. v. James M. Ashton
disposition: Motion to dismiss or affirm submitted April 3, 1911.
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of the United States for the Western District of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. W. P. Bell, Mr. Frederic D. McKenney, Mr. W. H. Doolittle and Mr. James M. Ashton for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam,.

Dismissed for want cf jurisdiction. McGilvra v. Ross, 215 U. S. 70; Shively v. Bowlby, 152 U. S. 1; Goodrich v. Ferris, 214 U. S. 71, 81; Farrell v. O’Brien, 189 U. S. 89; United States Fidelity &c. Co. v. United States, 204 U. S. 516, and cases cited. Mr. Benjamin S. Grosscup for the appellants.
